blocks.text: San Juan La Laguna – Santiago Atitlán – Antigua

paragraphs.ref: text:Day 3 · A boat tour of the Maya Tz’utujil towns of Lake Atitlán. First San Juan La Laguna (about 30 minutes by boat), a neat town of art galleries where painters work in the naïve style. Then Santiago Atitlán, founded in 1547 at the foot of the Atitlán volcano, the largest town on the lake, whose people live from fishing, farming and crafts such as painting, woodwork and weaving. Santiago is known for the veneration of Maximón, a folk figure who blends Maya and Catholic traditions, honoured with offerings of alcohol and cigars; visit the church, where both traditions meet, and the town hall, where the elders sit in their traditional embroidered dress. Back to Antigua. Overnight at Hotel Villa Colonial. (B)
